gloss: to be skilled at; to excel in

definitions.gloss: to be skilled at; to excel in
definitions.explanation: To have a high level of ability or expertise in a particular field or skill. Almost always used in the form に長けている to describe someone's proficiency.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{交渉|こうしょう}に{長|た}けている。
{言葉|ことば}の{扱|あつか}いに{長|た}けた{作家|さっか}だ。
examples.english: She is a writer skilled in the use of language.

examples.japanese: あの{会社|かいしゃ}にはITに{長|た}けた{人材|じんざい}が{多|おお}く{集|あつ}まっている。
examples.english: That company has gathered many people who excel in IT.

notes:
Almost exclusively used in the pattern ～に{長|た}けている. Rarely seen in other conjugated forms. Describes a developed, practical competence rather than innate talent.

PATTERN:
- ～に{長|た}けている (to be skilled at ~)
- ～に{長|た}けた + noun (skilled at ~ [modifier])

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {交渉|こうしょう}に{長|た}けている (skilled at negotiation)
- {技術|ぎじゅつ}に{長|た}けている (skilled in technology)
- {弁舌|べんぜつ}に{長|た}けている (skilled in speech/rhetoric)
